reply.text:
I'm sorry your knees and shins are aching. Pain in joints or limbs is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so please get that looked at before we change anything around it. I'm not going to judge what it is.

On the training side, I can help you switch things up. Tell me what you want to change, whether that's swapping the runs for cycling or building the rest of the week around what your body can handle, and I'll make the program change for you to confirm in the app.
